snippet.title: Alpha Nomos - Official Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Alpha Nomos is a rhythm-action roguelite where every attack, dodge and ability locks to the beat. Play Cello, fight corrupted puppets through advancing arenas and wield instruments as weapons, each one built from live studio recordings rather than a sample library. Play on-beat and you hit harder. Fall off it and the room punishes you.

This trailer shows off the Xyloblades, a pair of xylophone-swords that play a note every time they land. Each strike is both a hit and a sound, so combat doubles as a performance.

Alpha Nomos is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S following the PC launch.

Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529960/Alpha_Nomos/
